note.title: Free-time activities
note.specFocus: Hobbies, sport, music, cinema, television, reading, gaming, eating out, shopping, online leisure, and plans for leisure time.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Free-time activities

Key vocabulary
- el tiempo libre; practicar; tocar un instrumento; escuchar; ver; leer; salir; el videojuego; la entrada; la cartelera; quedar con; relajarse; disfrutar de; aficionarse a

Key grammar
- Use gustar/encantar/interesar and change the form for plural activities. Use hace + time expressions for how long, the preterite for a recent event, and near future/future for plans.

Exam tips
- Use ir al cine rather than ir a el cine. Distinguish ver (to watch) from mirar (to look at), and use tocar for playing an instrument.

2. I prefer watching comedies because they make me laugh.
3. Last weekend I went to the cinema and saw a Spanish film.
questions.question:
Listening-style written practice (read the transcript; there is no audio):

Lucía dice: «Los sábados toco la guitarra con un grupo de amigos. Prefiero ver comedias porque me hacen reír. El fin de semana pasado fui al cine y vi una película española.»

Answer in English.
1. What does Lucía say about the first topic?
2. What extra detail is given in the second statement?
3. What is the main idea of the final statement?
